default/30636.htm.text: Summoner Carmoniell Who are you? I am Carmoniell of the Elves. What have you come here for? This is my private building and it is not polite to wander around my property. Please, leave now. If you ignore my polite request, I shall ask my unicorn to make you leave.

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30636-01.html.text: Summoner Camoniell: Hello, young apprentice Summoner. Have you come to challenge me? I am not going to fight you right now, in fact, I will concede defeat. Here is my Arcana Card.

links.text: "That's absurd! I will not accept such a victory!"

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30636-05.html.text: Summoner Camoniell: That certainly took a lot longer than I expected... Let's stop fighting.

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30636-06.html.text: Summoner Camoniell: Hey, what do you think you're doing? How rude! How dare you touch my creature... Well, according the rules, I win!

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30636-10.html.text: Summoner Camoniell What do you want now? Stop harassing this poor old Elf, deprived of her lover and defeated by a mere apprentice... Oh, Eva! How can you be so cruel to me?...

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30636-02.html.text: Summoner Camoniell You don't even have an Arcana Card! How do you expect to fight? You can get a card from Trader Lara of the Town of Dion ...

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30636-03.html.text: Summoner Camoniell: Whew... You are tenacious, aren't you? Ready for a fight even as the world crumbles around you? All right, I accept your challenge to a duel. This will not be easy, but at least it should be over quickly. In fact, it shouldn't take more than a minute... Let me introduce my frien…

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30636-04.html.text: Summoner Camoniell: I'll hold your Arcana Card... You may order your creature to attack when ready...
